subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent task completion close run-owned temporary browser tabs by default, and which user actions should preserve a tab?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally keeps primary-session tabs reusable, so changing the default requires maintainer intent for the terminal event, ownership marker, and preservation contract.

options.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
options.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

options.title: Keep current reusable-tab model
options.body: Treat idle/cap cleanup plus reset cleanup as sufficient and close this direction as not planned if task-end closing is too surprising.

options.title: Opt-in strict cleanup
options.body: Preserve current behavior by default while adding a documented strict cleanup mode after the ownership model is defined.

recommendation.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
recommendation.body: Track tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the strongest recent browser cleanup and peer-scoped reset cleanup history around this exact behavior.
